extensions.value: The European Medicines Agency (EMA) has authorized cetuximab in combination with chemotherapy for the treatment of patients with epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR)-expressing, KRAS wild-type metastatic colorectal cancer. Cetuximab's product information further states that evidence of wild-type KRAS status is required before initiating treatment with cetuximab.
